operations.name: me
operations.description: 当前登录用户及其工作区成员关系。

operations.name: workspace
operations.description: 按 slug 获取工作区详情。

args.name: slug
args.desc: 工作区 URL 短标识

operations.name: project
operations.description: 按 ID 获取项目，含迭代列表。

operations.name: task
operations.description: 任务详情，含子任务、指派人、标签。

operations.name: tasks
operations.description: 项目内任务的分页查询，支持状态/指派人/标签过滤。

operations.name: search
operations.description: 跨任务 / 项目 / 评论的全文搜索。

operations.name: createTask
operations.description: 创建任务，可同时指定指派人、标签与父任务。

operations.name: updateTask
operations.description: 更新任务标题、详情、优先级、截止日期。

operations.name: setTaskStatus
operations.description: 流转任务状态（看板拖拽走此接口）。

operations.name: assignTask
operations.description: 替换任务的指派人集合。

args.name: userIds
args.desc: 指派人 ID 列表（全量替换）

operations.name: addComment
operations.description: 在任务下发表评论或回复。

operations.name: attachTag
operations.description: 把标签挂到任务上（幂等）。

Node.description: 所有带 ID 的对象

User.sdl:
type User implements Node {
  id: ID!
  email: String!
  name: String!
  avatarUrl: String
  timezone: String!
  memberships: [WorkspaceMember!]!
  createdAt: DateTime!
}

Workspace.sdl:
type Workspace implements Node {
  id: ID!
  slug: String!
  name: String!
  plan: Plan!
  owner: User!
  members(first: Int = 20): [WorkspaceMember!]!
  projects(includeArchived: Boolean = false): [Project!]!
  tags: [Tag!]!
  createdAt: DateTime!
}

Project.sdl:
type Project implements Node {
  id: ID!
  key: String!
  name: String!
  color: String
  status: ProjectStatus!
  lead: User
  workspace: Workspace!
  sprints: [Sprint!]!
  archivedAt: DateTime
  createdAt: DateTime!
}

Sprint.sdl:
type Sprint implements Node {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  goal: String
  startsOn: Date
  endsOn: Date
  status: SprintStatus!
}

Task.sdl:
type Task implements Node {
  id: ID!
  title: String!
  description: String
  status: TaskStatus!
  priority: Priority!
  position: Float!
  dueDate: Date
  project: Project!
  sprint: Sprint
  parent: Task
  subtasks: [Task!]!
  assignees: [User!]!
  tags: [Tag!]!
  comments(first: Int = 20): [Comment!]!
  attachments: [Attachment!]!
  createdBy: User!
  createdAt: DateTime!
  updatedAt: DateTime!
}

Comment.sdl:
type Comment implements Node {
  id: ID!
  body: String!
  author: User!
  parent: Comment
  createdAt: DateTime!
  editedAt: DateTime
}

Attachment.sdl:
type Attachment implements Node {
  id: ID!
  fileName: String!
  mimeType: String
  sizeBytes: Int!
  url: String!
  uploader: User!
  createdAt: DateTime!
}

TaskFilter.sdl:
input TaskFilter {
  status: [TaskStatus!]
  assigneeId: ID
  tagId: ID
  dueBefore: Date
  search: String
}

CreateTaskInput.sdl:
input CreateTaskInput {
  projectId: ID!
  title: String!
  description: String
  sprintId: ID
  parentId: ID
  priority: Priority = MEDIUM
  dueDate: Date
  assigneeIds: [ID!]
  tagIds: [ID!]
}

UpdateTaskInput.sdl:
input UpdateTaskInput {
  taskId: ID!
  title: String
  description: String
  priority: Priority
  dueDate: Date
}
